name: The Clogfather
status: Prototype181 recurring aimed volleys integrated; native and balance review pending
scope: First mission boss; rooted giant fatberg with moving pipe mouths and extensions.
canonical_metadata_note: Bestiary owns monster.json and artwork. This encounter proposal is not registered as a playable creature. Promote accepted HP into monster.json.health before runtime integration; runtime must not read duplicate health values from this proposal.
story_boundaries: Giant fatberg appearance is locked; mechanics and numeric tuning here are proposals.
Billy-Joe (BJ) is the AI; preserve selected playable plumber and separate support dialogue.
Post-boss portal is a proposed story beat. Destination, cause and connection to BJ remain unresolved.
No combat mechanic establishes proposed Flushfiend origins as canon.

health_proposal.rationale: 720 HP now requires 30 Sean plungers or 120 Tony pressure bolts. Sustained DPS is 24 versus 40; boss window/fight duration needs rebalancing after the starter-weapon nerf.
health_proposal.comparison_assumptions: Full damage against exposed weak point, no armor/upgrades/regeneration; all hits land. Counts do not include travel time, windup or overkill on summoned enemies.
health_proposal.duration_status: Unvalidated target; reassess after Sean damage drops to 24 and starting weapon ranges become 320/480 pixels.
health_proposal.status: Historical720HP proposal; superseded by canonical1080HP candidate and current_implementation_contract2026-10-20

arena.layout: Fixed camera, rooted body at right edge, flat continuous combat floor; no pits or required moving platforms.
arena.weak_point: Low forward pipe mouth extends into the arena at standing projectile height during recovery.
arena.melee_approach: Expose within 60 pixels of a safe standing position; body contact damage disabled throughout recovery.
arena.reachability_rule: Each hazard plan must leave a reachable connected safe corridor from current player position using the slower plumber. Validate travel time including acceleration and collision width; skip unsafe attacks.
arena.support_character: Off combat floor; does not attack, block projectiles, trigger hazards or become a required target.

future_numeric_profile.status: Proposed for 75/100 or 80/100 player health; blocked on final player health and full damage-scale migration

damage_to_player.rule: Use one explicit damage scale per build. Never apply 15/20 damage to current 5-HP players. Do not scale damage as a fraction of each hero max HP, which would erase Sean endurance advantage.
damage_to_player.contact_rule: Moving decorative pipes do not damage. Root body has a clearly marked collision boundary; contact can hurt only outside recovery.
damage_to_player.damage_events: One hit per collision event; shared invulnerability across boss, acid and summons prevents stacked damage.

weak_point.recovery_timer_starts: After hazards are harmless and approach grace expires; mouth is already visible/open during grace.
weak_point.opening_cue: Pipe uncoils and valve shutters spread; distinct release sound and shape change, not color alone.
weak_point.closed_hit_feedback: Distinct harmless deflection splash; no false damage flash or boss HP change.
weak_point.collision: Exposed weak-point collider overrides body shell so shots and melee can hit it.
weak_point.damage_deduplication: At most one boss damage application per attack/projectile/explosion, even when several pipe colliders overlap.
weak_point.phase_transition: Queue threshold changes until current recovery ends; never truncate a promised window. Lethal damage starts death immediately.

sludge_volley.cue: Selected pipe inflates, rattles and aims; show the firing lane.
sludge_volley.aim: Aim separately at current hero position at each emission; projectiles do not home.
sludge_volley.counterplay: Dodge current-position aimed shots; use the one-second burst gap.
sludge_volley.finish: Repeat during active combat; stop immediately on death/reset.

ceiling_acid.cue: Ceiling drips plus outlined floor stripes and hissing sound; warning footprint includes full splash radius.
ceiling_acid.counterplay: Walk out of marked columns; chosen corridor must be reachable before impact.
ceiling_acid.finish: Each drop lasts0.6s falling plus0.8s puddle. At<=20%HP next simultaneous volley begins2s after prior emission, with warning inside that cooldown and weak-point access retained.

summon_flushfiend.cue: A side pipe shakes; mark the exit before spawning.
summon_flushfiend.counterplay: Boss pauses attacks while the player clears the add; never spawn into a blocked escape route.
summon_flushfiend.finish: After add death, cancel its contact damage immediately and begin approach grace plus recovery.
summon_flushfiend.fallback: If no safe spawn location exists, skip summon and enter recovery.

sequence: single scheduled pattern; enrage gun groups may overlap acid
rules: Warned two-burst groups alternate with pressure/acid above20%HP; during enrage, independent warned groups may overlap acid and surviving summons. No new gun emissions during approach/recovery.
Never shorten telegraphs in later phases.
Later phases add coverage, not simultaneous unavoidable hazards.
Start each phase at the first item of its loop; phase advancement occurs after recovery.
At HP zero cancel queued patterns, hazards, summons and contact damage before starting death animation.

optional_valves.status: Optional prototype experiment; fight must remain beatable without valves
optional_valves.interaction: Explicit interact action at valve, not weapon hit; bind through normal input settings.
optional_valves.availability: Only during a telegraph with a safely reachable valve; never while recovery is already open.
optional_valves.effect: Interrupt telegraph, consume the shared phase charge, and enter normal approach grace plus five-second recovery.
optional_valves.restrictions: No chaining, no damage multiplier, no health cost, no mandatory character swap or support action.
optional_valves.readability: Mechanical latch and pressure gauge show ready/spent state; both valves share the same charge.

defeat_and_retry.defeat: Clear danger immediately, play nonlooping collapse, leave harmless fatberg wreckage, then emit boss_defeated.
defeat_and_retry.portal: Optional story listener may reveal portal after collapse; no portal destination or cause encoded in combat.
defeat_and_retry.checkpoint: Before arena, full selected-character health on retry; restore boss HP, phase, valves, timers and adds.
defeat_and_retry.dialogue: Opening banter skippable and omitted automatically on repeated attempts; gameplay hazards paused during dialogue.

art_requirements: Rooted fatberg body and independently moving pipe mouths/extensions.
Six existing health states; phase tells separate from HP damage-stage appearance.
Sludge windup, firing, acid warning, summon warning, weak-point opening/closing, stagger and nonlooping collapse.
Sludge projectile, acid drop/puddle, telegraph footprints, valve ready/spent and weak-point hit effect.
Shared anchors and collision-readable silhouettes; no frame-by-frame body rescaling.
acceptance_checks: Both starting ranged weapons can defeat the boss without unlocks, valves or support-character actions.
Exact health-state boundaries follow shared policy; phase thresholds tested at 480 and 240 HP.
At least one connected safe corridor is reachable with current 235-pixel/second movement and collision geometry.
Five-second recovery survives phase transitions; death overrides everything immediately.
No damage is applied twice through body/weak-point collider overlap or splash.
Acid targeting freezes when warning starts; later patterns cannot occupy the promised safe corridor.
Melee-only future loadouts can reach the weak point without contact damage during recovery.
Pause, retry and death clear timers, hazards and summon state; optional valves cannot be spammed.
Test both legacy and future damage scales separately; reject mismatched player-health configuration.
Measure completion time with both plumbers before accepting 720 HP and the 40–75-second target.

current_implementation_contract.owner: Engineering delivery; Game Mechanics isolated controller; Art assets/anchors; Level Design placement
current_implementation_contract.health: 1080 HP initial playtest candidate, canonical monster.json source; no difficulty HP multiplier.
current_implementation_contract.loop: Opening warned two-burst volley, then alternate pressure-to-acid and warned two-burst volleys, each followed by0.8s approach and full5s recovery. Each burst rolls1–3 shots; every shot aims at the current hero, with no homing and exactly1s between bursts. At or below20%HP preserve two-second acid emissions and continuous weak-point access: each acid-warning boundary may arm a separately warned two-burst gun group only when the previous group is fully idle. Skip busy opportunities without backlog. No new gun emissions during approach/recovery.
current_implementation_contract.window: Mouth unfolds during approach; becomes damageable for the full5s window. Body contact disabled for approach and recovery. No threshold truncation; phase advances after full window, lethal hit immediate.
current_implementation_contract.geometry: Room-local960x540,floor440,HUD0..110. Artroot810,440; shellRect(700,120,255,320); weakpointRect(626,377,48,42); sludge nozzle(675,255). Walkable/acid span0..700 covers both edges. Harmless rootwisps may extend left to615; configure geometry before start.
current_implementation_contract.acid_safety: Locked columns include splash width. Reserve connected corridor>=180px reachable at235px/s with0.15s reaction margin and actual hero width; at most35% floor marked. If no safe plan, skip pattern into recovery.
current_implementation_contract.projectile_safety: Existing projectile speed, per-mode spacing, swept collision and finite lifetime retained. Independent enrage warning is visible and audible without resetting acid timing. Death/reset cancel warnings and emissions.
current_implementation_contract.retry: Preboss checkpoint; full boss and selected hero HP,phase1,empty hazards/timers,normal life debit once. Keep completed Skitterling and earlier segments completed; suppress repeated banter.
current_implementation_contract.death: Clear danger immediately,nonlooping1.2s collapse,one boss_defeated event; progression outcome belongs to Storyboarding/Engineering.
current_implementation_contract.api: scripts/clogfather_encounter.gd provides reset/start/step/hit/drain_events/hurt_rects/snapshot; Engineering maps world coordinates, rendering, music and actual hero damage.
current_implementation_contract.balance_validation: Measure both heroes; target40–60s is a playtest aim, not guaranteed by HP. Current starters75DPS each; ideal1080HP firing14.24/14.16s before travel/misses.
current_implementation_contract.art: Existing source sheets need smooth pressure/sludge/acid/lowmouth open-close/hit/death and coherent health-stage compositing. Gross HUD must preserve readable continuous actual HP and existing green/yellow/red thresholds.
current_implementation_contract.checkpoint: World checkpoint13800; arena14150..15110,commit14230,completion15150 afterterminaldefeat. Engineering owns worldadapter; no portal ininitialdelivery.
current_implementation_contract.phase_progression: Phase changes remain at recovery boundaries. At or below20%HP, the current weak-point selection stays accessible and acid repeats without waiting for a new recovery. Existing high-point airborne-attack requirement retained.

pressure.status: Prototype96 implementation; live balance review pending
pressure.gas_health: Encounter hazard:5 times active hero weapon damage,60HP forTony/90HP forSean; exactly5 hits each. No change to monsterHP or weaponDPS.
pressure.policy: Exact complete formations; no silent drops or mid-wave refill. Live gas and reinforcement monsters persist through acid, sludge, recovery and subsequent waves until killed. Pressure durations schedule the next attack; they are not hazard lifetimes. Pause freezes hazards; boss defeat and encounter reset/retry clear them. Normal damage, hit/death feedback and shared immunity remain active in every phase. No cough/control interruption. No automatic population cap or age-based removal; surviving waves accumulate. Escape corridors exclude only the newly scheduled attack, not older surviving hazards. Pressure-only time ends when the acid warning starts; the total appearance-to-drop interval is2s.
pressure.volley_rounds_by_mode: Two bounded bursts per group on all difficulties. Groups recur in alternating attack cycles, or at idle acid-warning opportunities during enrage.
